name: Discord
description: Post and read in Discord over the v10 REST API (discord.com/api/v10) as a bot, or through a channel webhook with no bot at all. Send, edit, delete and react to messages; start threads; list servers and channels; read recent messages to follow a conversation. The bot token is stored as DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN and never printed. Writing to a channel requires a human to have allowed that channel id on this machine. Mentions are rendered as text: an agent cannot ping @everyone.
